title: One Lab-Grown Meat Plant Is About To Get Way Bigger
hook: One plant alone will make 400,000 pounds a year.
closing: Data would still rather have a sandwich.
question: Would you actually try cultivated meat?

segments.say: The largest cultivated-meat plant's next facility will make 400,000 pounds of meat a year -- eight times more than today's.
Even that upgraded plant is tiny next to the 50 billion pounds of chicken the US makes every year.
The number of approved cultivated-meat companies in the US has more than doubled in two years.
